title: Policy Iteration for Stationary Discounted Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman Equations: A Viscosity Approach
summary: We study policy iteration (PI) for deterministic infinite-horizon discounted control problems characterized by stationary Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equations. For general viscosity solutions, the classical gradient-based policy improvement step need not be defined pointwise. We introduce a semi-discrete formulation with centered difference quotients at scale $h$ and a separate artificial-viscosity term of order $O(h)$.
